why: Nothing after 26 January 2024 touches the count: Lu-Zaman-Zhao is a finite zero-free check not about idoneal numbers (none), and Weicun Zhang's GRH claim never mentions idoneal numbers, bears only via a conditional reduction (none), and carries several F10 signals together (not_credible). doubts: Whether Stopple's range exclusion is unconditional, and whether Chowla's qualitative finiteness should count as a bound, are close calls; neither changes the outcome. Weinberger's cap (one vs two) is disputed in the record's sources.
